records.name: Polier Lotrecht
records.biography_en: Knows the building is crooked because the plan says otherwise. His HyperNorm plans permit only straight walls and straight answers. A dissonant card folds neatly along a corner that the drawing says cannot exist. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Abweichung liegt eindeutig beim Gebäude.

variant_notes.note_en: Knows the building is crooked because the plan says otherwise.

records.name: Elektrikerin Kontaktfreudig
records.biography_en: Finds a connection in everything except the instructions. She sorts HyperNorm cables into connected and awaiting connection. A dissonant card asks whether two neighbours can agree without sharing the same circuit. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Verbindung steht. Ihr Sinn wird noch gesucht.

variant_notes.note_en: Finds a connection in everything except the instructions.

records.name: Maurer Fugenfüller
records.biography_en: Believes every gap is a personal request for assistance. He fills every HyperNorm gap with mortar before anyone can call it a doorway. A dissonant card suggests leaving one opening for a late neighbour. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Lücke wurde aus Fürsorge geschlossen.

variant_notes.note_en: Believes every gap is a personal request for assistance.

records.name: Zimmermann Restmaß
records.biography_en: Measures twice because the first measurement took the afternoon off. His folding rule measures HyperNorm rooms in approved increments. A dissonant card expands whenever he tries to round it down. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Zweimal gemessen. Dreimal anders ausgefallen.

variant_notes.note_en: Measures twice because the first measurement took the afternoon off.

records.name: Kranführerin Schwebend
records.biography_en: Moves heavy things gently and interruptions with less care. Her controller moves HyperNorm loads between authorized resting places. A dissonant card asks whether hovering can count as a decision. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Last schwebt bereits über der Zuständigkeit.

variant_notes.note_en: Moves heavy things gently and interruptions with less care.

records.name: Betonwart Schonhart
records.biography_en: Has learned that waiting can become structurally permanent. He mixes HyperNorm certainty until it sets. A dissonant card leaves a little footprint in the wet argument, although none of the residents have feet. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Wartezeit ist inzwischen tragfähig.

variant_notes.note_en: Has learned that waiting can become structurally permanent.
